title: Learning to Reason in Real-Time
abstract: arXiv:2611.33513v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: AI agents that operate in the real world must reason correctly and on-time, yet they currently do not account for how time should alter their reasoning. Modern agents learn to do tasks in environments that are entirely synchronous: where the world waits for the agent to act before changing. A real-time environment, by contrast, changes independent of the agent. Existing approaches try to bridge this gap by imposing a ratio of thinking to acting. However, for an agent to succeed in real-time it must learn to act quickly when delay is costly and to reason longer when the benefit outweighs the missed opportunities. To this end, we introduce real-time reasoning training (RRT) as the class of training techniques for real-time reasoning agents. We develop three standard RRT techniques: (1) using real-time data, (2) decoupling acting and observing, and (3) curriculum learning in time. translated_abstract: 在现实世界中运作的AI智能体必须正确且及时地进行推理，然而目前它们并未考虑时间应如何改变其推理方式。现代智能体是在完全同步的环境中学习执行任务的：即世界会等待智能体采取行动之后才发生变化。相比之下，实时环境的变化则独立于智能体。现有方法试图通过强制规定思考与行动的比例来弥合这一差距。然而，要在实时环境中取得成功，智能体必须学会在延误代价高昂时迅速行动，并在收益超过错失机会的损失时进行更长时间的推理。为此，我们提出了实时推理训练（RRT）这一类针对实时推理智能体的训练技术。我们开发了三种标准的RRT技术：（1）使用实时数据，（2）解耦行动与观察，（3）时间维度的课程学习。这些简单的技术相结合，大幅超越了……
tldr: 该论文提出了实时推理训练（RRT）框架及三项标准技术——使用实时数据、解耦行动与观察、时间维度课程学习，使智能体学会根据时间成本权衡快速行动与深入推理，从而在实时环境中大幅超越传统同步训练方法。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces Real-Time Reasoning Training (RRT) with three standard techniques—using real-time data, decoupling acting and observing, and temporal curriculum learning—enabling agents to learn when to act quickly versus reason longer in real-time environments, substantially outperforming conventional synchronous training.
